whatIs: useHooks is a collection of ready-to-use React hooks, created by the ui.dev team. It includes pieces like useDebounce, useLocalStorage, useMediaQuery, useWindowSize, useCopyToClipboard and useClickAway, each with documentation and a live example.
You install it with the @uidotdev/usehooks package, or you can copy a hook's code into your project if you only need one.
uses: Delaying a search while the user types with useDebounce.
Saving preferences in localStorage and keeping them in sync with useLocalStorage.
Closing a menu or a modal when you click outside it with useClickAway.
caveats: The repository hasn't received changes since May 2025, so check that the hooks you need work with your version of React.
Hooks like useFetch, useInterval or useCountdown only come in the package's experimental version, which requires experimental versions of React and React DOM; it's not for production.
pricingNote: Free and open source under the MIT license; ui.dev sells courses separately.
idealFor: React projects that need common hooks without writing them from scratch.
